title: Project Workspace Mutation and Build Pipeline
goal: Define how NEXUS will safely plan, preview, apply, validate, and roll back project workspace changes under explicit project boundaries and approval gates while project mutation and build execution remain blocked until later subphases explicitly allow them.
userImpact: Founders and operators get a concrete enterprise path from PRD/work order to governed project change planning without fake live project edits, raw patch dumps, hidden spend, or unsafe command execution.
commandCenterImpact: P138.1 preserves Command Center UX and establishes the future build UX requirements. P138.4 owns any future Command Center project build UX changes.
safetyImpact: Project mutation, patch application, build/test execution, rollback execution, provider/model calls, tool execution, MCP startup, agent dispatch, DB/runtime writes, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, and spend remain blocked in P138.1.
costImpact: No provider, model, network, DB service, deployment, export, package, tool execution, agent-dispatch, or project build spend.
safetyRules: Do not mutate project files in P138.1.
Do not run builds against project workspaces in P138.1.
Do not apply patches, write DB/runtime state, call providers/models, execute tools, start MCP servers, dispatch agents, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend in P138.1.

Do not expose project/private raw IDs, raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, raw registry dumps, raw patch dumps, raw diff dumps, secret values, mutation controls, build controls, deploy controls, package controls, or spend controls in primary UX.

Future workspace mutation packets must include explicit selected project profile, allowed path globs, forbidden path globs, patch plan, build/test plan, rollback plan, approval gate, evidence refs, activity refs, and cost impact before any live project mutation is considered.
reuseRequired: Reuse shared/resultEnvelope.js for future runtime envelopes when needed.
Reuse shared/modeGuard.js and shared/redaction.js for future mutation/build admission work.
Reuse os-roadmap/updatePhaseStatus.js for status changes when applicable.
Reuse existing project registry, scope boundary, evidence, audit, activity, route matrix, and Command Center card/badge patterns as evidence only.

Do not duplicate report writers, checker formatters, result envelopes, mode guards, redaction helpers, phase status updaters, route matrices, UI cards/tabs/badges, or activity/evidence/audit appenders.
requiredPlanFields: starting branch and expected base commit

Do not run builds against project workspaces in P138.1.
Do not apply patches, write DB/runtime state, call providers/models, execute tools, start MCP servers, dispatch agents, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend in P138.1.

Future workspace mutation packets must include explicit selected project profile, allowed path globs, forbidden path globs, patch plan, build/test plan, rollback plan, approval gate, evidence refs, activity refs, and cost impact before any live project mutation is considered.
